v1.name: V1 readiness
v1.status: Supervised pilot: mobile dashboard repair merged, premium Fargate skill/image delivery and live handoff still unproven
v1.summary: Nov 2: businessbuilder main 97868b89 is CodeBuild-success; phone usability #915 merged with real phone/browser test coverage, and release-gate #924 merged after exposing hollow-green CI verdicts. Captured production ECS flags from #925 (web :447/worker :285) show WEBSITE_BUILDER_BACKEND=aws, SMART_ONBOARDING_ENABLED=true and TEAM_CHAT_SMART_ENABLED=true; snapshot alone does not verify the phone fix or customer journeys on the live image. The skill-side browser change (selfoperate-front-end-skill #1), Stromation skill host/image #333 and businessbuilder task wiring #920 remain OPEN; image library/approval remains missing. No complete accepted Fargate skill build, 3 premium handoffs, unattended recovery or restore proof.

v2.name: V2 readiness
v2.status: Five-worker platform and switches exist; repeated provider-backed operating outcomes unverified
v2.summary: Captured production web :447/worker :285 has TEAM_CHAT_SMART_ENABLED=true, daily recap and multiple workers/integration switches; the newly merged marketing, no-code form, phone and dashboard improvements do not demonstrate repeated useful real-provider outcomes from all five workers, owner-delivered recaps or unattended recurring recovery. Print orders are sandbox and expanded print pieces/marketing remain gated.

v3.name: V3 / Full 10/10 vision
v3.status: Mobile/code and release-gate progress, but premium site handoff, complete SaaS, custom agents and economic autonomy unproven
v3.summary: Businessbuilder #915 repairs observed premium phone defects in merged code; release-gate #924 rejects all-skipped CI green runs; redacted production revision :447/:285 confirms enabled smart chat and onboarding, but not independently validated phone or full live business outcomes. Premium website skill integration still gated by three open PRs and missing picture sourcing/approval; no accepted Fargate delivery. Complete SaaS, automated custom agents, 95-99% routine autonomy and 1-2 founder technical hours weekly remain unproven.

autonomyProof.note: Representative success/attempt denominator is still unavailable; do not imply the 95–99% V3 mature target has been measured.

founderWorkload.note: Darius minutes are not comprehensively separated from operator effort, customer approvals or specialist review.
